gsc.note: CANONICAL HOST IS THE APEX, NOT www — www.electricwheelchairmalaysia.com.my 307-redirects to the apex, so every Google property is keyed to https://electricwheelchairmalaysia.com.my/ (same convention as 24hourelectrician.my / water-tank.my). localePrefix=as-needed (en at /, ms at /ms, zh at /zh); /en/* redirects to /*. The /ms/ and /zh/ URL-prefix properties reject the root sitemap (sitemap path must sit under the prefix), so only the Domain + canonical / properties carry the full multi-locale sitemap. Bulk indexing requested 211/288 URLs before the daily Indexing API quota (~200/day/project); the remainder is re-runnable next day via gsc-submit.mjs --finalize on the canonical URL.
